name: Cold Plum Sword Primer (Hàn Mai Kiếm Quyết)
concept: The outer gate's method is practised barefoot in the snow under the plum trees of the old seat above Hàn Mai, at dawn in the coldest month. The cold drives the student's qi inward to the bone, where Metal qi hardens it, and the plum's Wood gives it a little spring (only kim is named so outer disciples without Wood pass CongPhap.usable under the school's Metal-only gate rule). It teaches five straight thrusts and nothing else for six years.
lore: Lăng Đạp Tuyết's own training, made into a method when he opened the school in 1105 (V051). He still teaches the first winter himself.

name: Plum Through Snow Sword Canon (Mai Xuyên Tuyết Kiếm Kinh)
concept: The school's canon, which the founder learned watching a winter plum bloom through the snow: a hard branch that holds and a flower that opens at the worst moment. The cultivator tempers her meridians with Metal qi until they will not bend, then lets a thread of Wood qi run along them (only kim is named so inner disciples with Metal+Earth roots pass CongPhap.usable under the school's Metal-only gate rule, while Five Petals still lays Wood stacks). The sword forms are five petals; each opens on a hit, and the fifth opens when the holder is most hurt.
lore: Lăng Đạp Tuyết made it between 1105 and 1162 and reworked it after the school moved up to the iron town, when the tiger-stripe ore gave it the hard branch it lacked.

name: Lone Branch Sword (Độc Chi Kiếm)
concept: The head's own art: one branch that blooms when every other tree is bare. The holder fights better with no companion than in company; with no companion, her sword arts cost less and strike harder, and the first killing blow she would take in a fight leaves her one breath to answer it.
lore: Made after his daughter Lăng Nhược Mai died to the tiger of Thạch Khẩu in 1162. He has taught it to Trác Thiết Cán and Phó Ngạo Sương and to no one else.
